purpose: Coordinate parallel additive, research-first changes without disrupting production SportsEdge.

notes: The live NBA props collector and learning system already run; do not change schedules, automatic model-switch policy, budget or release controls here.
The stock PAPER schedule is on, but brokerWritesEnabled is false on main; PR #102 is not a shortcut for owner acceptance.
Real money is disabled. No workstream can enable betting, trading, order submission, or Kalshi access.

defaultSafetyGates: Work on one isolated branch per domain, only additive/read-only changes until reviewed.
No merge to main or deployment without code review and green full regression.
Preserve sealed forward decisions and existing research-data append-only records.
Point-in-time availability must precede forecast lock; unavailable is not zero.
No new paid sources, secrets, provider accounts, live data dispatch, new orders or model promotion.
Manual approval for new scheduled collection even if source is free.
Shadow performance uses genuine future forecasts, not old data labeled as forward.
Keep current collection budgets, model selection, PAPER stake and stock release flags unchanged.

streams.title: Release firewall and regression baseline
streams.deliverable: Snapshot protected settings and current workflows; test release-diff and risk-switch changes; audit PR dependencies.
acceptance: No active production or write-capable file changed without explicit review
All modified PRs have repeatable regression/check evidence
Owner rollback and alert paths documented

streams.title: NFL/NHL public data archive and compatibility
streams.deliverable: Read-only live source preflight, verify NHL/NFL asset schema/license; bounded daily append-only archive.
acceptance: Real provider source downloads verified independently
No schedules activated without owner consent
Retry/deduplication and partial-failure preservation proven

streams.title: MLB, WNBA, NCAAF, NCAAB, extra soccer
streams.deliverable: Source rights register and one provider adapter per league; schedule/final schema fixtures.
acceptance: Source license and access documented
Unique event IDs, UTC observation time, finalization checks
Per-source no-cost/request caps, failing unknown schemas

streams.title: Permanent point-in-time research memory
streams.deliverable: Pure, unintegrated timeline/provenance audit prototype in #176; next add adapters on separately reviewed read-only branches.
acceptance: Late observations excluded from pregame/pre-release features
Corrections append new versions, never mutate prior snapshots
Idempotent backfill never invents historical prediction times

streams.title: NBA props uncertainty and challenger evaluation
streams.deliverable: Rest/calendar defect review; minutes uncertainty, line-gap and More/Less calibration as separate frozen challengers.
acceptance: All changes remain shadow-only
Chronological out-of-season holdout and game-clustered CI
Reject models with no significant calibrated improvement

streams.title: All-candidate prediction and paper audit
streams.deliverable: Audit existing every-line saved prediction path, labeling paper picks separately from candidate-only lines.
acceptance: No credit usage increase
All pending/graded/void/stale cases explicitly distinguished
Virtual P/L is only from settled paper entries

streams.title: Risk-sized paper staking research
streams.deliverable: Compare flat stake to bounded alternatives on genuine forward-calibrated evidence.
acceptance: No change to live $5 virtual stake
Bad calibration or missing sample leads to $0 shadow suggestion
Correlation/exposure limits tested

streams.title: Supervised Monday PAPER evidence
streams.deliverable: Read-only decision-to-fill provenance panel, owner preflight and reconciliation diagnostics.
acceptance: No write permission or order dispatch added
No mutation to stock release flags, account gate or #102
Unknown fill/reconciliation is not reported as P/L

streams.title: Stock momentum, quality, psychology and day-trading research
streams.deliverable: Pre-registered cost-aware historical and forward-only challenger experiments, with SPY/exposure baselines.
acceptance: No strategy promotion based solely on backtests
Fees, slippage, corporate actions, survivorship and embargoes audited
At least 26 forward weekly samples for strategy confirmation as appropriate

streams.title: NOAA weather and BLS CPI public-event memory
streams.deliverable: Independent weather and CPI observed-data snapshots with revisions and availability time.
acceptance: Real source schema verified
No Kalshi quotes or exchange calls
No automatic forecast declared without pre-release freeze

streams.title: Prediction-market opportunity research only
streams.deliverable: Legal/terms/age/account eligibility checklist and research-only settlement convention; no market API access.
acceptance: No real-money or exchange order integration
Written rights/eligibility decision before any quote ingestion
Independent probability calibration proven before discussing edge

streams.title: Chat-first command center integration
streams.deliverable: Integrate informal questions/Kalshi evidence from #174 with read-only tool registry/multi-turn security of #168 without overwriting shared page/chat edits.
acceptance: Never calls owner account loaders anonymously
Untrusted text injection rejected
Missing/stale evidence reported as unavailable
No assistant tool can execute trade, bet or state mutation

streams.title: Versioned learning experiments and research intake
streams.deliverable: Preserve C→D dependency; experiment registry, provenance and SEC filing-time guard; bounded diagnostics only.
acceptance: No self-promotion or active-model writes
Source availability strictly earlier than decision
Pre-registration fingerprints and terminal rejected states
Reject backfilled forecasts falsely labeled forward

streams.title: Explainable performance and reliability UI
streams.deliverable: Read-only cross-domain yesterday/today comparison, accuracy vs confidence, attribution and provenance panels.
acceptance: Dates and timezone labels explicit
Small-N warnings and denominator displayed
Charts never imply profitability without settled receipts

streams.title: API budget and workflow health observability
streams.deliverable: Read-only freshness/failed-job checks, spend estimates, duplicates, missing scores and research collector run health.
acceptance: No new secret exposure or monitoring bill
Only actionable failures alert
Missing collection distinguished from zero opportunities

streams.title: Mobile and accessibility polishing
streams.deliverable: Preserve dark/green glass UI; improve tables, safe mobile layout, semantic navigation and loading/error states.
acceptance: 48-route/viewport smoke or newer equivalent passes
Keyboard navigation and contrast audited
No change to existing API behavior

streams.title: Controlled review and merge sequence
streams.deliverable: Per-PR dependency, CI, rights and rollout report; explicit merge checklist and rollback before promotion.
acceptance: No silent merge/deploy or activation
No pending higher-impact owner gate bypassed
Shadow and prod metrics compared after supervised rollout

knownCollisions.resolution: Create an integration branch after reviewing both diffs; preserve #168 tool/auth boundaries and #174 colloquial + Kalshi routing. Do not blindly merge either.
#167 targets #166's head. Rebase and land C before D; review merged registry history and tests.
Consolidate existing checks rather than overwrite/duplicate the workflow.
#168 reads ledger types; verify owner-only access and updated schema from #171.

excluded: Automated live risk or model release
